notes: AMBIGUOUS FEE: The instructions first provide a broad certified-copy rate of $15 for the initial copy and $10 for each additional copy. They later distinguish certificate types, pricing an extended form at $35/$30 and a short form at $15/$10. I treat the later, type-specific rule as controlling. Because the earlier language is broad enough to create a conflict, receipts for the affected types record the interpretation, require review, and show what the alternative reading would have cost. Billed $65.00 for 2 copies; the alternative reading gives $25.00, a $40.00 difference. Confirm with the City Clerk (311 or 212-NEW-YORK) if disputed.
